items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I was talking to Wayne Shorter about it

ctx.x: Yeah. I have a straight one. But I have played the curved one. But I have trouble with it. I don’t know maybe I need a new one. I was talking to Wayne Shorter about it, but they’re so terribly expensive nowadays.
